description: Search for car rental options between cities. Find available vehicles with pricing, specifications, and rental terms for specific dates and locations. Returns one page of cars in sort_by order: limit cars (default 7, maximum 20). data.total_count is how many cars the search found, data.returned_count how many are listed; when data.pagination.has_more is true, page 2, 3 and so on list the rest. Prices have every campaign applied, as the booking link charges; price.priceBeforeCampaign and campaign show the discount. Filter by transmission, car_class and max_deposit in the search itself instead of paging through the results; search_link opens the site with the same filters (not the sort). unlimitedKm true means no mileage limit (limitedKm is then a negative placeholder such as -1, not a distance); location.distance is the office's distance in km from the searched place, and sort_note says when sorting by distance makes no difference there. When the response has location_options, a place name fits more than one place: tell the user which place was searched and offer the others; to search one of them, call again with its name as given. Use this instead of fetching the site's pages when you need its prices or availability. Use when the user wants a rental car for given pickup and drop-off places and dates. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, times HH:MM. Prices already include the site's campaigns. When the user wants an automatic or manual car, a car class such as SUV, or a low deposit, pass transmission, car_class or max_deposit instead of paging through results. To give a booking link for the car the user chose, pass request_id and the car's referenceId to car_allocate.

driver_age.description: Driver age (minimum 18; defaults to 25 if the user didn't say)

max_deposit.description: Only cars whose deposit (blocked on the credit card) is at most this amount. The deposit has its own currency, shown in each car's deposit.currency; abroad it can differ from the price currency (e.g. GBP or EUR).

page.description: Page number from 1 (default 1); page 2, 3 … continue the same search

sort_by.description: Sort criteria: 'recommended', 'price_asc' for cheapest first, 'price_desc' for most expensive first, 'distance' for nearest first, 'review' for highest rated, or 'review_count' for most reviewed

trip.description: Trip type: 'domestic' for local or 'international' for cross-border travel

name: car_search
title: Search rental cars
